title.narrative: Volume(mass) of BOD pollution load removed by treatment plant in Sharqui and Menoufia under the project

comment.narrative: <p>No BOD treatment under the new WWTPs is done because they are not constructed and operational in the Menoufia and Sharkia governorates.  The original target is zero as this indicator was not part of the original RF. </p>

title.narrative: Number of wastewater treatment plants meeting Egyptian effluent treatment standards.

comment.narrative:
<p>None of the WWTPs have been completed by project closure or by the ICR mission (March 2019).  However, several of them are at advanced stages of construction (90+ percent), so with the continued financing from the GoE funds they can be brought to comletion.  </p>
<p> </p>

title.narrative: Total number of additional working wastewater connections in Sharkeya and Menoufia

comment.narrative:
<p>The original indicator was 100 percent then dropped and replaced as a number.</p>
<p>The project has completed 9,139 HHCs/ inspection chambers, which are very close to the households ready to be connected when the WWTPs become functional. No actual achieement is reported for the indicator because beneficiaries are not connected and are not using the constructed chambers.</p>

title.narrative: Number of WWTPs operating at 2017 design flow rate in Sharkeya and Meoufia

comment.narrative:
<p>The original target was 100 percent then it was dropped and replaces with a number.</p>
<p>The three (3) WWTPs financed under the project are still under construction and not yet completed.  Interim constrictuion progress as of the ICR mission in March 2019 was: in the Sharkia governorate - Debeg WWTP at 85 percent, Qanteer WWTP - 50 percent; in the Menofia governorate - Dansour WWTP - 95 percent.</p>

title.narrative: Number of WWTPs operating at 2017 design flow rate in Assuit and Sohag

comment.narrative:
<p>The original target was 100 percent then it was replaced to a number.</p>
<p>The two WWTPs financed under the project are still under construction and not yet completed.  Status of construction is as follows: Assuit governorate: Al-Nwarah WWTP - 56 percent, Shotp WWTP - 80 percent.</p>

comment.narrative: <p>No treatment under the new wastewater treatment plants is done because the WWTPs are not completed. The only sewage treatment (3,262 m3/d) is happening in Sohag through an existing WWTP, therefore only 4.5 percent of the targeted BOD pollution load is removed through the treatment.</p>

comment.narrative:
<p>The original target for training courses was as a number, or 60 courses, which was changed to a percentage and was fully achieved.  </p>
<p> </p>

title.narrative: Increased number of people in the project areas connected to improved sanitation and sewerage services.

comment.narrative: <p>The original target was 100 percent  and was replaced with a number.  The achievement on the ESMMF training exceeds the set target (114.3 percent).</p>

title.narrative: Total number of additional working wastewater connections in Assuit and Sohag
Total kms of sewerage pipelines laid in Assuit and Sohag

comment.narrative:
<p>Fully achieved against the revised target.  The increase in the contracts signed than the target is due to termination of 2 contracts (1 in Sohag & Assuot each) under phase (2) and splitting it into 4 contracts. </p>
<p>The original target of 90 contracts was reduced at restructuring to reflect the scaled down scope and changes in technical specifications. Thus, 22 percent ahieved against the original target. </p>

title.narrative: Total number of pumping stations constructed in Assuit and Sohag
Total number of pumping stations constructed in Assuit and Sohag

comment.narrative: <p>Constructed pump stations indicate that 100 percent of the civil works have been finished and all the electro-mechanical equipment is stored on the site. The majority of the pump stations are ready for commissioning and start-up in both governorates. A number of pump stations are already working.  100 </p>

title.narrative: Total kms of sewerage pipelines laid in Assuit and Sohag

comment.narrative: <p>85.5 percent or the revised target and 43.9 percent of the original length of the constructed sewerage pipelines have been achieved.</p>

<p>This was added as a core indicator at restructuring.  The 5,000 functional HHCs were in the Sohag governorate whereby they got connected to an existing operational WWTP in Sohag. Thus, the 25,000 beneficiaries (formula used: 5 people per HHC) were reached , which compares poorly against the original target of 1,200,000 and revised target of 878,340 and later the target of 285,000 beneficiaries (2.1, 2.9, and 8.8 percent, respectively).  50% of the (25,000) benefited population were females.</p>

title.narrative: Increased number of people in the project areas connected to improved sanitation and sewerage services.

comment.narrative:
<p>Same comment as in the "Direct project beneficiaries" whereby only 25,000 beneficiaries (corresponding to 5,000 HHCs)  were reached representing 8.8 percent of the reduced target. </p>
<p>The project has built 37,781 HHCs/inspection chambers that are ready to be connected to the HHs when the WWTPs become operational, potentially reaching to 188,905 additional beneficiaries (66 percent of the reduced target).  </p>

<p>Because no WWTPs were completed / became functional by project closing, the only treatment of additional wastewater is happening at the exiting WWTP in Sohag for the 5,000 functional HHCs.  The volume of wastewater treated reached 3,262 m3, representng 2.7, 4.4, and 5.9 percent, respectively, against the targets.</p>
<p>???????</p>

title.narrative: Total number of additional working wastewater connections in Assuit and Sohag

comment.narrative:
<p>The original target was 100 percent then it was dropped and replaced with a number.</p>

<p>The project has constructed 28,643 inspection chambers ready for the HHs to connect, however, only 5,000 HHs were connected to the chambers and then to an existing functioning WWTP through the sewer network in Sohag. </p>

<p>9.75 percent achievement.</p>

title.narrative: Number of construction supervision contracts signed for treatment plants

comment.narrative: <p>The target was revised from 4 to 6 at the second restructuring for strengthened construction supervision.  100 percent achieved. </p>
